findings.title: Haunted by grief, Gaza's displaced still wait overseas for return
findings.affected_population_system: Gazans displaced outside the Gaza Strip; return and repatriation
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Some 7,000 have returned to Gaza, many remain abroad.
findings.bounded_discovery_context: Published at 00:03 PT, after the prior heartbeat completed at 23:50:30 PT. Reuters reports current Palestinian Authority displacement figures and a return count.

coverage_notes.summary: One new qualifying displacement follow-up was found. OCHA OPT and WHO were checked first and had no separate in-window operational update.
